test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A x B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is M related to Q if ‘M + N – O ÷ P × Q’?
solution:

Given Expression: M + N – O ÷ P × Q

M + N: M is the son of N.

N – O: N is the brother of O.

O ÷ P: O is the father of P.

P × Q: P is the wife of Q.

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68b7a81fb991efcf695905c9d4651b1007290c8c18552add10621c09218d7c6c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c95f1488b8fcb595bad32c19f1905dbf5239b008ae3d1a4cca225131044dc8b6.png] 

Therefore, M is the **Wife's Father's Brother's Son** of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
